2026-09-28 12:38:36.231797 | controller | Also=, or Alias= settings in the [Install] section, and DefaultInstance= for
2026-09-28 12:38:36.231803 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-09-28 12:38:36.231807 | controller |
2026-09-28 12:38:36.231810 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-09-28 12:38:36.231814 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-09-28 12:38:36.231817 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-09-28 12:38:36.231821 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-09-28 12:38:36.231824 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
